title: Dominic and the Glasshouse
author: Silas Villalobos
blurb: Ansel Ravensworth, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
